features.source: The lower Chinookan peoples of the Columbia River and its estuary, including Chinook, Clatsop, Kathlamet, Wahkiakum and Willapa communities. The river was their trade and fishing corridor, not a centralized Chinook state. The span ends in 1860, by which point removals, disease and settler land claims had displaced most Chinookan people from full-time life along the Columbia's banks.
